Question: Assalamo Alikum Sometime ago I saw a dream that I and my close friend (a class fellow)are in Masjid Al-Aqsa. Reclining with the wall of the hall of the Mosque we are looking towards Qubbat As-Saghra (Dome of Rock). Later another friend of mine also saw me there.A common thing in both the dreams, that of mine and my friend, is that the people in control of the area,who seem to be jews, dont say me anything. Infact they stop my friend but once I come they allow him as well to enter the mosque. Normally I dont remember any dream. I am happy to find myself at such a holy place in the dream but worried about the way jews treat me. But I also know interpretations of dreams may not be like what they apparently seem to be. please tell me the correct interpretation. Hope you reply soon. looking for the answer. Answer ID: 6519 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1640/1241=H/1429) The meaning of the dream is that your friend is having better religious feelings compared to you. Both of you should mutually strive to make progress in religious matters. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
